notes:
Sophia works on top of the tools your team already uses. Your property management system, accounting software, investor portal, CRM, file storage, Microsoft Teams, and Slack all stay in place. Sophia connects them and moves work between them, so your data stays where it lives and nobody has to learn a new system.

Work flows without the copy and paste. Today, a person carries every task from one system to the next: pulling reports, retyping numbers, checking spreadsheets, and chasing approvals. Sophia’s AI Co-Workers (workflows) do those handoffs for you. Each step’s finished output starts the next one, whether that’s an off-market deal search that ends in a draft letter of intent or a monthly asset management report built from several property managers’ files.

Your team stays in control. Every handoff lands in Teams or Slack for a person to approve, modify, or reject, and every step is logged in a full audit trail.

You see the payoff. The Sophia platform tracks every hour and dollar saved, so leadership and investors can see the return.

The result: your team spends its time on deals and decisions, and your firm takes on more properties without adding headcount.
